title: Uniform integral equals expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set equipped with a measurable space in which every singleton is measurable, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The integral of $f$ with respect to the measure induced by the uniform probability mass function on $\Omega$ equals the expectation of $f$ under that uniform distribution.
